summary.en-US: Expand and collapse all replies below a reply on x.com as a nested thread, with like, repost, reply and bookmark right in the thread. Unofficial, not affiliated with X Corp.
summary.de: Klappt auf x.com alle Antworten unter einer Antwort als verschachtelten Thread auf und zu, mit Gefällt mir, Reposten, Antworten und Lesezeichen direkt im Thread. Inoffiziell, nicht mit X Corp. verbunden.

description.en-US:
On a post page on x.com, a button “Show replies (N)” appears below every reply that has replies of its own. One click expands all posts underneath as a nested tree, level by level, instead of opening every reply one by one. Each level can be collapsed again.

Features:
- Expand threads, also for replies loaded while scrolling; 16 px indentation per level keeps deep threads readable
- Reply, repost or quote, like, bookmark and share directly in the thread view; name and avatar link to the profile
- Profile card when hovering over a name or avatar, like X's own: bio, following, followers, “Followed by …”, follow button and profile summary
- Optional: expand all replies automatically when opening a post
- Optional: show replies X hides as “probable spam”
- Optional: wider middle column on large windows
- 29 languages

Privacy: the extension only runs on x.com and only uses the permission “storage” for its three settings. It sends requests only to x.com, with your existing X session, exactly like X's own web app. No analytics, no tracking, no third-party servers, no data collection.

The extension relies on X's internal web interfaces and may stop working when X changes them. X's terms of service restrict access through unpublished interfaces; use at your own risk.

Unofficial project, not affiliated with or endorsed by X Corp. “X” is a trademark of X Corp. Source code (MIT): https://github.com/comax424/x-thread-toggle
description.de:
Auf einer Beitragsseite von x.com erscheint unter jeder Antwort, die selbst Antworten hat, ein Button „Antworten anzeigen (N)“. Ein Klick klappt alle Beiträge darunter Ebene für Ebene als verschachtelten Baum auf, statt jede Antwort einzeln zu öffnen. Jede Ebene lässt sich wieder einklappen.

Funktionen:
- Threads aufklappen, auch für Antworten, die beim Scrollen nachgeladen werden; 16 px Einrückung pro Ebene hält auch tiefe Threads lesbar
- Antworten, Reposten oder Zitieren, Gefällt mir, Lesezeichen und Teilen direkt in der Thread-Ansicht; Name und Profilbild führen zum Profil
- Profilkarte beim Überfahren von Name oder Profilbild, wie bei X: Bio, „Folge ich“, „Follower“, „Gefolgt von …“, Folgen-Button und Kurzprofil
- Optional: beim Öffnen eines Beitrags alle Antworten automatisch aufklappen
- Optional: von X als „wahrscheinlich Spam“ ausgeblendete Antworten einblenden
- Optional: breitere Mittelspalte bei großen Fenstern
- 29 Sprachen

Datenschutz: Die Erweiterung läuft nur auf x.com und nutzt nur die Berechtigung „storage“ für ihre drei Einstellungen. Sie schickt Anfragen ausschließlich an x.com, mit deiner bestehenden X-Anmeldung, genau wie X' eigene Web-App. Keine Statistik, kein Tracking, keine fremden Server, keine Datenerhebung.

Die Erweiterung nutzt X' interne Web-Schnittstellen und kann ausfallen, wenn X sie ändert. X' Nutzungsbedingungen schränken den Zugriff über nicht veröffentlichte Schnittstellen ein; Nutzung auf eigenes Risiko.

Inoffizielles Projekt, nicht mit X Corp. verbunden oder von X Corp. unterstützt. „X“ ist eine Marke der X Corp. Quellcode (MIT): https://github.com/comax424/x-thread-toggle

release_notes.en-US: Expanded posts now look and work like x.com's own posts (layout, icons, emoji, relative times), with x.com's Grok button and ⋯ menu (follow, Lists, mute, block, embed, report, Community Notes). New profile card when hovering over a name or avatar, with follow button and profile summary.

version.approval_notes:
Thread View for X adds a button below replies on x.com post pages that expands all nested replies as a tree, plus the usual actions (like, repost, bookmark, reply) inside that tree.

How it works:
- Content scripts run only on https://x.com/*. thread-toggle.js runs in the MAIN world because it observes x.com's own GraphQL request (TweetDetail) and repeats it with another post ID to load replies. bridge.js (isolated world) passes the three popup settings to it via data attributes on <html>.
- No remote code is loaded and nothing is evaluated (no eval, no new Function, no injected scripts). For write actions x.com requires an x-client-transaction-id header. Only when the user clicks such an action, the extension calls the function x.com's own already-loaded webpack bundle uses to compute that header (thread-toggle.js lines 63-76: it gets the bundle's webpack require via webpackChunk_twitter_responsive_web.push, picks the x.com module whose source contains 'x-client-transaction-id', and calls its exported 3-argument function). It reads query IDs from the text of x.com's main.*.js with a regular expression (thread-toggle.js line 83); that text is never executed.
- All network requests go only to x.com with the user's existing session, like x.com's own web app. No analytics, no third-party servers, no data collection (data_collection_permissions: none). Only permission: storage.
- The profile card shown when hovering over a name (thread-toggle.js section 3b) loads the account with x.com's UserByScreenName query and the accounts the viewer follows with x.com/i/api/1.1/friends/following/list.json, like x.com's own hover card. Its follow button calls x.com/i/api/1.1/friendships/create, destroy or cancel only when the user clicks it (unfollow and cancel ask for confirmation first). “Profile summary” links to x.com/i/grok?text=@handle in a new tab.
- To look exactly like x.com, expanded posts are built by cloning (cloneNode) an existing x.com reply element on the page and replacing its text content; all post content is inserted with textContent / DOM nodes, never innerHTML. x.com's own menu is opened once invisibly to copy its markup and icons, then closed again.
- Texts of menus and notices are read from x.com's already-loaded translation module (webpack module cache, read only; no exported function is called to find it). The Grok button and “Profile summary” call the openGrok function that x.com attaches to its own post components, found by walking the React fiber of an x.com post element; if it is not available, x.com/i/grok opens in a new tab. In-app navigation uses history.pushState plus a popstate event, the same state format x.com's router uses.
- Menu actions call x.com's own endpoints only on click: friendships/create|destroy|cancel, mutes/users/create|destroy, mutes/conversations/create|destroy, blocks/create|destroy (blocking asks for confirmation first). Lists and report open x.com's own dialogs; embed opens publish.x.com.
- The code is neither minified nor bundled. Source and history: https://github.com/comax424/x-thread-toggle (tag v1.4.0).

To test: log in to x.com, open any post with replies, and click “Show replies (N)” below a reply. Liking, reposting and replying act on the reviewer's own X account, so bookmarking (on, then off again) is the side-effect-free way to test a write action. The profile card appears when hovering over a name in an expanded thread for half a second.
